at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary amounts with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

review_comments: [team convention] Round money only with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent). Python's round() and a bare Decimal.quantize() use banker's rounding and give wrong invoice totals.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0002.title: Convert amounts with to_money and ZERO
at-0002.content: Wrap raw amounts with ledgerly.money.to_money before arithmetic and seed sums with ledgerly.money.ZERO, as line_total and invoice_total do in ledgerly/invoice.py.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid input by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a stable snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount", passing the offending value as the message.

at-0004.title: Exclude bool when validating ints
at-0004.content: When validating an integer argument, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False are ints in Python.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: Use `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` to normalize any incoming datetime (arguments and model fields like `sub.started_at`) before comparing or doing arithmetic in billing functions.

at-0006.title: Convert floats via str to Decimal
at-0006.content: When accepting float amounts or rates, convert with Decimal(str(value)) before doing money math so binary float artifacts do not leak in; to_money() rejects raw floats.
